findings.issue: ROUND-1 FINDING, RESOLVED AT THIS HEAD. Raised as MINOR at a81c00cdda: «Cuộc trò chuyện» was byte-identical to ui.chat.sidebar.nav.chats, so the F6 walk announced one name for the nav and the transcript. The head under audit carries the translator's «Khung trò chuyện»; this auditor re-read the value and accepts it. Recorded as INFO because the value being audited is the fixed one and no unresolved finding remains — the round-1 severity above is kept verbatim so the downgrade cannot be mistaken for a clean first pass.

{clock} is supplied by checkpointClockLabel() as 12-hour «h:mm AM/PM», while the vi guide's numbers/dates section specifies 24-hour times. Code-level format outside the catalogue; the vi value consumes {clock} as given. Unchanged at this head, not counted.

With {label} = «Không có tác nhân» the sentence reads «Tác nhân: Không có tác nhân. Gán tác nhân»; the repetition is inherited from the English design («Agent: No agent. Assign an agent») and the sidecar requires {label} verbatim for voice-control matching. Not counted.

«Không có tác nhân» is 17 cells against English 8. The chip is min-w-0 max-w-[24ch] truncate, so it renders whole (17 <= 24) and the conversation title yields instead; no overflow in the styles. No rendered-frame claim. Not counted.

The header and transcript landmarks deliberately share one accessible name (chat-regions.ts maps both onto this key; the English sidecar records the sharing). The vi walk therefore announces «Khung trò chuyện» twice in one F6 cycle, exactly as English announces «Conversation» twice. Design, not translation. Not counted.
Shares «Khôi phục cuộc trò chuyện» with ui.chat.sidebar.row_menu.unarchive (the two surfaces never render together). Unchanged at this head, not counted.

«Thao tác với câu trả lời» and «Thao tác với tin nhắn của bạn» stay distinct as the sidecar requires, and «Thao tác với X» matches the existing ui.browser.browser_tab_strip.tab_actions pattern. Not counted.

The longest new menu item «Khôi phục cuộc trò chuyện» is 25 cells; the existing vi row menu already carries «Chuyển cuộc trò chuyện xuống» (27) and «Tách nhánh cuộc trò chuyện» (26). No overflow finding; no rendered-frame claim. Not counted.
